wins: Build a wide board of Mutants and Ninjas, then use Sneak to slip Leonardos and Ninja Turtle tokens into combat at instant speed for a big alpha strike.
plan: Featherbrained Filcher, Action News Crew, Leonardo (Cutting Edge or Big Brother), April O'Neil, Lita.
Agent Bishop and Mighty Mutanimals add counters; East Wind Avatar and High-Flying Ace attack in the air. Remove blockers with Dimensional Exile or Uneasy Alliance.
Attack, then during declare blockers return an unblocked creature to sneak in Leonardo, Leader in Blue (+2/+0 to your team) or The Last Ronin's Technique (three attacking tokens).
Sally Pride makes a 2/2 for each of your nontoken creatures and adds counters every attack.
keys: Sneaked in, he gives your whole team +2/+0 for the turn.
Three 1/1 tokens; with Sneak they enter tapped and attacking.
A token for each nontoken creature you control, then counters on every attack.
A +1/+1 counter on an attacker every attack, levelling into lifegain and team-wide counters.
tips: Sneak: cast the card for its sneak cost during the declare blockers step by returning one of your unblocked attackers to your hand. Recast the returned creature later.
Return a cheap or "enters"-value creature (Mighty Mutanimals, April O'Neil) to sneak, so you get its trigger again next turn.
Grounded for Life costs 3 less against a tapped creature: use it after they attack.
Action News Crew can be channeled late for a counter on every creature and a card.
Jennika can plainscycle for 2 when you need a land.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 Plains with two or more creatures that cost 1–2.
